```{r}
#| label: site-data
# Everything below is computed from the site's own content, so the numbers
# and "Latest" cards stay current as projects, tutorials and papers are added.
library(jsonlite)
pubs <- fromJSON(here::here("_data", "publications.json"), simplifyVector = FALSE)

n_papers   <- length(pubs$publications)
n_cites    <- sum(vapply(pubs$publications, \(p) if (is.null(p$cited_by)) 0 else p$cited_by, numeric(1)))
n_projects <- length(Sys.glob(here::here("projects", "*", "index.qmd")))
cites_label <- if (n_cites >= 10) paste0(floor(n_cites / 10) * 10, "+") else as.character(n_cites)

# Newest tutorial (highest `order`)
tut_files <- list.files(here::here("tutorials"), pattern = "\\.qmd$", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
tuts <- lapply(tut_files, \(f) c(rmarkdown::yaml_front_matter(f), path = f))
latest_tut <- tuts[[which.max(vapply(tuts, \(t) as.numeric(t$order), numeric(1)))]]
latest_tut$href <- sub(paste0("^", here::here(), "/"), "", latest_tut$path)

latest_article <- pubs$articles[[1]]          # sorted newest first by the fetch script
latest_paper   <- pubs$publications[[1]]      # sorted newest first by the fetch script

shorten <- function(x, n = 22) {
  w <- strsplit(x, "\\s+")[[1]]
  if (length(w) > n) paste0(paste(head(w, n), collapse = " "), "…") else x
}
```

::: {.home-intro}
I'm a bioinformatician and computational biologist with over 15 years in biomedical science, including 10 in tuberculosis research. I started at the lab bench, processing clinical samples and running flow cytometry, went on to coordinate multi-site clinical studies, and now build the pipelines and analyses that turn genomic and clinical data into results. I'm currently a Data Analyst at Stellenbosch University and completing an MSc in Computational Biology.

[View projects](projects.qmd){.btn .btn-primary}
[About me](about.qmd){.btn .btn-outline-primary}
:::

## Latest

```{r}
#| label: latest
#| output: asis
card <- function(kind, icon, title, href, meta, text) {
  cat(
    "::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4 .latest-card}\n",
    sprintf('[<i class="bi %s"></i> %s]{.latest-kind}\n\n', icon, kind),
    sprintf("[[%s](%s)]{.latest-title}\n\n", title, href),
    sprintf("[%s]{.latest-meta}\n\n", meta),
    sprintf("%s\n", text),
    ":::\n\n", sep = ""
  )
}
cat("::: {.grid .latest-grid}\n\n")
card("Tutorial", "bi-mortarboard", latest_tut$title, latest_tut$href,
     sprintf("Tutorial %s", latest_tut$order), shorten(latest_tut$description))
card("Article", "bi-pencil-square", latest_article$title, latest_article$url,
     sprintf("Medium · %s", format(as.Date(latest_article$date), "%d %B %Y")),
     shorten(latest_article$excerpt))
card("Paper", "bi-journal-text", latest_paper$title,
     if (!is.null(latest_paper$doi)) paste0("https://doi.org/", latest_paper$doi) else "publications.qmd",
     sprintf("*%s* · %s", latest_paper$journal, latest_paper$year),
     sprintf("Co-authored, cited %s times. [All publications →](publications.qmd)", latest_paper$cited_by))
cat(":::\n")
```
